inputs: industry_alignment/curriculum_gap_matrix.md (41 gaps: 6 P0, 7 P1, 15 P2, 5 P3, 8 P4)

method.claim_strength_rule: progress_achievement: defensible (badge's non_claims disclaim role-readiness). applied_skill (competency_badge, narrow): overclaimed if badge lists a P0-blocked skill OR claims a critical_competency with P0 blockers; otherwise defensible. cross_section_capability: overclaimed if P0-blocked skill/competency OR ≥5 missing in-scope role skills; otherwise defensible. capstone_credential (verified_credential): overclaimed if P0-blocked OR ≥3 missing in-scope skills; underclaimed if lists P1-partial skill; otherwise defensible.
method.decision_rule: progress_achievement → retain. overclaimed + P0-blocker → strengthen (close gap before issuing). overclaimed + ≥8 missing in-scope → split. overclaimed (other) → strengthen. underclaimed → rename. defensible → retain.
